Traffic Control From Hell

Four signals on a 2×2 grid during a held-out rush hour (17:00–18:00, same arrivals for every controller). Two busy avenues run east–west; Elm St is a medium north–south street; Quiet Lane carries about one car a minute. Queued cars turn amber after 30 s and red after 90 s. Watch Quiet Lane under the queue-greedy rules.

Held-out results

Mean ± std over 20 arrival seeds per pattern. Waits are per signal crossing; worst waits include cars still waiting when the hour ends.

Demo episode: first held-out rush-hour seed. 'Cars still driving' along a link are drawn as faint dots near the upstream end; the simulator tracks them as a delay line, not positions. Fixed-time is tuned on training demand (cycle and split per street); the guard threshold is tuned the same way.
